content:
# The project file of the capture: an app, its managed database, a job and a preview template, all of the project "blog".
# It is the one file that still has the legacy spelling (a top-level `previews`, `run` for a host job), so that the agent reports
# deprecations for it and the dashboard's handling of them is pinned to what the agent says.
apps:
  - name: blog
    image: ghcr.io/acme/blog
    environment: staging
    domains: [blog.example.com]
    port: 2368
    soak: 0s
    database:
      password_file: "/work/data/postgres/roles/blog"
previews:
  - app: blog
    domain: "pr-{pr}-blog.example.com"
    env: {NODE_ENV: "<hidden>"}
    ttl: 24h
    max: 3
jobs:
  - {name: blog-reindex, schedule: "@hourly", container: {app: blog, command: [reindex]}}
  - {name: blog-prune, schedule: "@weekly", run: [/srv/prune.sh]}
